mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_points_record (user_id, type, points, balance_after, biz_type, biz_id, description, expired_time, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{points}, #{balanceAfter}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{description}, #{expiredTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stellar_points_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, user_id, type, points, balance_after, biz_type, biz_id, description, expired_time, create_time FROM stellar_points_record WHERE type = 1 AND expired_time IS NOT NULL AND expired_time >= #{now} AND expired_time <= #{deadline}
